notes.ja: ランダムな味方 1 機への発動者基準の攻撃力▲（5 秒）は未対応（説明文にきっかけの無いクールタイムごとのアクティブとみられ、周期を録画で読んでいない。V-0898）
notes.en: The caster-based ATK up on 1 random ally (5 s) is not implemented (it looks like a cooldown-based active skill with no trigger in its description, and the cooldown has not been read from recordings. V-0898)

notes.ja: 味方全体への遮蔽物 HP 回復は、それ自体は与ダメージを変えない（遮蔽物の HP の回復を読む効果のある編成でだけ効く。きっかけが説明文に無く、時刻を撮っていない）
notes.en: Restoring the cover HP of all allies does not change damage by itself (it matters only in squads with effects that read cover HP restoration; the trigger is not in its description and its timing has not been recorded)

assumes.ja: 遮蔽物が破壊された味方がいない時の枝（射撃場の敵の攻撃では遮蔽物は壊れない前提で、いつもこちら）。ランダムな味方 1 機（自分も候補）に、リリーのバフ前の攻撃力 × 説明文の値を足す（10 秒）。モデルは期待値で、候補が k 機なら全員に値の 1/k を付ける
assumes.en: The branch for when no ally's cover has been destroyed (always this one, assuming the shooting range enemy's attacks never break cover). Lily's pre-buff ATK × the value is added to 1 random ally (herself included) for 10 s. The model uses the expected value: with k candidates, each gets 1/k of the value

notes.ja: 遮蔽物が破壊されたランダムな味方 1 機への遮蔽物の復活と発動者基準の攻撃力▲（10 秒）は、被弾を扱わないので遮蔽物が壊れず、起きない
notes.en: Rebuilding the cover of 1 random ally whose cover has been destroyed, with a caster-based ATK up (10 s), does not occur, since damage taken is not modeled and cover is never destroyed
